boundary: PASS proves proposition-aware lens selection, explicit handoff contracts, and structural receipt closure. A branch closes only when targetRef, lens and preferred organ match and the return carries explicit execution status, provenance, material and relation-to-target. RESOLVED_BY_RECEIPT certifies contract return only; it does not certify semantic correctness, evidence quality, or truth of the target proposition. VAJRA→GUT regressions preserve compact target references and inherited-target anti-echo.
